page.content:
David Clarke (born 13 September 1929 and died 27 July 2002) was a British racing driver. At the 1953 British Grand Prix, he was a substitute driver from Bob Gerard, but his services were not needed during the race.

page.overview:
Who is David Clarke?

David Clarke (born 13 September 1929 and died 27 July 2002) was a British racing driver. At the 1953 British Grand Prix, he was a substitute driver from Bob Gerard, but his services were not needed during the race.
